title: Crestline Fleet Account Fleet Size Credit on Mobile Visit Fees
content:
Larger Crestline Fleet Account rosters earn a fleet size credit, taken off the fee a contested mobile service visit owes.

| The account's roster shows enrollments beyond its removals | Fleet size credit |
|---|---|
| 50 or more | 5.00 |
| 30 to 49 | 2.50 |
| fewer than 30 | nothing |

"Enrollments beyond its removals" is the number of vehicle enrollment entries on the account's roster less the number of vehicle removal entries on it, over the roster's whole history.

## Boundaries (hypothetical rosters)

| Enrollment entries | Removal entries | Beyond removals | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 62 | 13 | 49 | 2.50 |
| 63 | 13 | 50 | 5.00 |
| 40 | 11 | 29 | none |
| 40 | 10 | 30 | 2.50 |

The fee owed is never below 0.00, the floor being applied once after every addition and credit, not to each amount in turn.
